user_story: As a staff member, I want deleting a confirmed booking to return an error so that active reservations are protected.

positive.title: Attempt to delete a confirmed booking results in an error
steps: Log in as a staff member.
Navigate to the reservations management page.
Attempt to delete the confirmed booking.
positive.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the confirmed booking cannot be deleted.

negative.title: Attempt to delete an unconfirmed booking
steps: Log in as a staff member.
Navigate to the reservations management page.
Attempt to delete the unconfirmed booking.
negative.expected_result: The unconfirmed booking is successfully deleted without errors.

edge.title: Attempt to delete a booking that is in the process of being confirmed (booking status is pending)
steps: Log in as a staff member.
Navigate to the reservations management page.
Select a booking that is in a pending status.
Attempt to delete the pending booking.
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the booking in a pending state cannot be deleted until confirmation status is resolved.
